pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Nether Doll is immune to fire and lava damage.

• HP: 120
• Regen IV + Resistance II + Fire Resistance
• Immune to fire / lava damage and the Wither effect

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Combat
• Melee/Archer mode auto-fires fireballs (20 damage on direct hit; all hostile mobs within 3 blocks also take splash damage and burn for 5s; 3s cooldown)
• While holding the Nether Sword, all its burn durations are doubled (melee 16s, flame arrow 16s, fireball 10s)

Aura
• Nether-mob pacify: Nether mobs within 16 blocks cannot build aggro on the doll or its owner
• Fire-resistance aura: the owner within 16 blocks gains constant Fire Resistance
• Lava freedom: within 16 blocks the owner is not slowed in lava and can move freely

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text:
Surround the center with 8 netherrack to craft the Nether Doll Egg.

Name the egg on an anvil, then right-click the ground while holding it to summon the doll.
